build_dataset_builder: build a tfds GeneratorBasedBuilder for the Oxford 102 flowers dataset with image, label, and file_name features
create_split_generators: create split generators for train, test, and validation splits from downloaded image and annotation archives
generate_examples: generate examples by yielding image paths, class labels, and file names from MATLAB annotation files
configure_dataset_info: configure dataset info with FeaturesDict containing image, ClassLabel with 102 flower names, and file_name fields
download_and_extract: download and extract images, labels, and setid archives from the Oxford Flowers 102 dataset URL
